findings.title: Su üzerinden arındıran hareket
findings.claim: The focus's water and purification vocabulary forms a medium-action-result relation: water is applied by washing over exposed bodily surfaces, so purification is materially enacted rather than merely named.
findings.mechanism: The focus joins washing, water, cleansing, and exposed bodily surfaces. The registered root facets let the water be read as both the ordinary medium and the active carrier of the cleansing motion, while the face and hands identify the surfaces on which that motion is performed.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive purification as a directed material process in which water reaches the body and restores its ritual surface.
findings.containment: This preserves the literal washing rite and does not make water the only possible purification medium; the earth substitute remains a distinct provision in the same focus.

epistemic.reason: The claim is carried by a trusted focus-anchored channel with exact focus occurrences, registered branch facets, and direct support for the water-medium and washing relations.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey ya da kişi kirden, lekeden veya kusurdan uzak olduğunda kendinde temizdir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's purification state marks the person as clean and free from impurity.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus separately names washing and water as the medium and action associated with reaching that state.
branch_activations.activation: The clean-state branch becomes materially legible when the washing and water occurrences supply the means by which impurity is removed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Purification is a concrete return from impurity to a clean bodily state.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not reduce the whole rite to a generic physical cleaning claim.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: suyla veya eşdeğer bir araçla yıkanıp temizlenme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi suyu veya onun yerini tutan bir aracı kullanarak yıkanır ve temizlenir.
branch_activations.carrier: The purification occurrence carries washing with water or an equivalent medium as a person's cleansing action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus explicitly supplies water and the washing verb alongside the purification result.
branch_activations.activation: The medium and action occurrences activate the branch's person-centered washing facet within the focus's purification instruction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ordinary path is a person being washed and cleansed through a medium.
branch_activations.boundary: The equivalent-medium wording does not erase the focus's separate distinction between water and earth.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: kendisi temiz, başkasını temizleyen su veya araç
branch_activations.facet_statement: Aynı su veya araç, kullanıldığı başka bir şeyi temizleme gücüne sahiptir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus attributes purifying power to the medium as it cleans another thing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Water and washing identify the substance and motion that pass toward the exposed body.
branch_activations.activation: The purifying-medium facet connects the named divine purification result to water acting upon the person rather than merely accompanying the command.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Water is both substance and instrument in the restoration of ritual cleanliness.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not make the medium independently sacred or claim that the wording settles every theological account of purification.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin üzerine su akıtılır, üzerindeki kir giderilir ve şey temizlenir.
branch_activations.carrier: The washing verb carries water being run over a thing so that dirt is removed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus identifies face and hands as exposed bodily surfaces included in the instructed washing.
branch_activations.activation: The surface occurrences give the washing action a bodily target and turn the root's water-over-surface motion into the focus's ritual procedure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Washing is a pass of water across the body's named surfaces that removes what obstructs cleanliness.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not claim that every surface or every physical effect is specified beyond the focus's stated members.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: su ve su adının biçim ailesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderge, bilinen ve içilen sudur.
branch_activations.carrier: The water occurrence carries the ordinary known and drinkable substance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Washing and purification assign that substance the role of cleansing medium.
branch_activations.activation: The ordinary water sense is activated by the focus's washing action and purifying result.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The first medium is ordinary water made operative in a ritual cleansing process.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary-water reading does not deny the focus's explicit provision for an alternate medium.

findings.title: Temiz toprağın taşınan arınma ortamı
findings.claim: When water is absent, the focus selects clean earth and has the hand pass it over face and hands; earth therefore becomes a mobile ritual medium through hand-to-surface contact.
findings.mechanism: The substitute sequence links earth, clean material, wiping, face, and hands. The earth is not left as a static location: the hand carries the medium across exposed surfaces, preserving the role map of medium, operative limb, surface, and cleansing pass.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the substitute rite as an enacted transfer in which the hand makes clean earth ritually mobile.
findings.containment: This preserves earth and wiping as the specified substitute and does not claim physical or theological equality between earth and water. The 5:4 clean-permitted-material parallel supplies only a contextual facet for the clean-material wording.

epistemic.reason: The claim is supported by a trusted focus-anchored channel with exact registered facets for earth, clean material, wiping, face, and hand, plus a bounded 5:4 contextual parallel.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Az ya da çok genişlikteki yeryüzü yüzeyi dalın temel gönderimidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The earth occurrence carries the surface of the ground as the selected material.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus pairs that surface with clean material and deliberate recourse when water is unavailable.
branch_activations.activation: The clean-earth phrase turns ordinary ground into the material selected for the fallback act.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The substitute medium is a real earth surface made available for the rite.
branch_activations.boundary: The earth surface is not being equated with water or with every possible meaning of ground.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bağlama göre hoş, temiz, iyi veya dinen izinli olan
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan için bilgisizlikten ve kötü davranıştan arınmışlığı, toprak içinse pislik taşımamayı belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The clean-material occurrence marks material that carries no impurity.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus contrasts the selected earth with the absence of water and places both within a cleansing procedure.
branch_activations.activation: Earth and water absence constrain the clean adjective to a material suitability that makes the substitute usable.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The earth must be clean in the concrete sense of not carrying impurity before it is passed over the body.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not extend the adjective into a general moral characterization of the person performing the rite.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bağlama göre hoş, temiz, iyi veya dinen izinli olan
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dinsel değerlendirmede yenmesine ya da kullanılmasına izin verilen şeyi gösterebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The clean-material occurrence carries a suitability that can include permitted use.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The nearby 5:4 material names good and permitted things in a legal setting.
branch_activations.activation: The 5:4 legal-material context gives the same clean root a bounded permitted-use resonance in the focus's substitute material.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Clean earth is not merely available ground; it is material permitted for this constrained ritual use.
branch_activations.boundary: The 5:4 parallel is contextual only and does not replace the focus's direct cleanliness requirement.

branch_activations.facet_statement: El veya başka bir araç bir şeyin üzerinden geçirilir; bu geçiş yüzeydeki ter gibi bir izi de kaldırabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The wiping occurrence carries an instrument passing over a surface and removing a trace.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The substitute names face and hands as the surfaces receiving the pass.
branch_activations.activation: The named surfaces give the wiping verb its ritual route and allow the clean earth to be transferred across them.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The fallback is performed by passing the selected material over face and hands.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not infer a broader physical scraping action beyond the focus's ritual gesture.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yüz ve bir şeyin öne bakan yanı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Canlılarda yüz denen organı ve yüz bölgesini belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The face occurrence carries the bodily face and its forward-facing region.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wiping verb supplies the action performed over that region.
branch_activations.activation: The bodily surface gives the substitute's wiping instruction a concrete target.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The first destination of the earth-bearing pass is the person's literal face.
branch_activations.boundary: The face is not being turned into a symbol that displaces the bodily procedure.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: el ve elin uğradığı bedensel durumlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderim, insan bedenindeki el organıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The hand occurrence carries the human hand as the operative bodily organ.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wiping occurrence assigns the hand a place among the surfaces receiving the selected material.
branch_activations.activation: The hand is both named surface and implied operative limb, making the earth-to-body transfer physically enactable.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The substitute rite uses the hand as the concrete point of contact for clean earth and bodily surface.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the hand's operative role cancels its simultaneous status as a named surface.

findings.title: Tamamlanma içinde zorunluluğa yol
findings.claim: The earlier declaration of completion and completed favor makes the focus's emergency route legible as part of a complete order: adaptation through illness, travel, absent water, and an alternate medium is one of completion's mechanisms rather than a defect in an otherwise uniform rule.
findings.mechanism: The earlier declaration of completion contains an emergency hunger allowance and closes with protective mercy. The focus repeats completion after illness, travel, water absence, and an alternate medium. Accommodation is therefore part of what makes the order complete, not a defect in an otherwise uniform rule.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive resilience under scarcity as constitutive of completion: the fallback is a viable path already held inside the order.
findings.containment: The focus's fallback remains a literal ritual provision. This legacy_unbound HFT reconstruction is qualified: the unresolved 5:3 context branches have no verified lexical gloss or facet and are retained only for their supplied attributed roles. No universal jurisprudential or theological generalization is claimed.

epistemic.reason: The HFT payload explicitly supplies the before/after reading, structural cues, and nine-entry trace, but its context branches are unresolved and the source is legacy_unbound; exact focus returns and attributed HFT roles support a qualified reading.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: Water absence and the selected earth identify the practical object and condition of that recourse.
branch_activations.activation: The HFT trace attributes deliberate direction to the act by which the person turns toward an available substitute.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Adaptation is an intentional route through the order, not an accidental relaxation of it.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not claim that every emergency response is morally deliberate beyond the focus's stated act.

findings.title: Ellerin ölçülü gücü
findings.claim: The focus's repeated hands can be read, with legacy qualification, as exercised power being reset for measured public action under hostility: purification recalibrates agency before it is extended or restrained.
findings.mechanism: The focus twice marks hands. The following context demands justice under hatred, then depicts hostile hands extending and being restrained. Washing the hands can thus reset exercised power before public standing, so agency is neither released by animus nor answered by uncontrolled retaliation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive hand purification as opening a transition from bodily reset to disciplined public action, where capacity is measured before it acts.
findings.containment: This remains an attributed HFT overlay, not a lexical definition of purification. The 5:8 connection carries reciprocal counterevidence that the procedure does not add to justice, so the finding does not claim that 5:8 explains the rite or mandates public justice from it. The unresolved 5:8 and 5:11 branches have no verified gloss or facet.

epistemic.reason: The HFT payload supplies the before/after reading, seven-entry trace, and exact focus/context coordinates, but the external context branches are unresolved and the 5:8 connection includes reciprocal counterevidence.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Hand purification can be overlaid as preparation for action not governed by hatred.
branch_activations.boundary: This context branch is unresolved and does not claim that hatred lexically explains the purification instruction.

branch_activations.activation: The HFT role connects cleansing with the measured conduct required when affect could distort judgment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The purified hand is overlaid as capacity placed under a justice-oriented measure.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection's reciprocal counterevidence remains active: the procedure is not claimed to add to or define justice.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The hands can be perceived as power that must be measured before it is extended.
branch_activations.boundary: The extension scene is unresolved HFT context and does not alter the literal object of the focus's washing.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, güç ve bir işi yapabilme yeterliğidir.

findings.title: İyiliğin bağlayıcı karşılığı
findings.claim: The focus's completed favor returns in 5:7 as remembered favor joined to covenant and the response of hearing and obeying, making provision legible as a delivered good that elicits binding response.
findings.mechanism: The focus's favor occurrence is carried back to the immediate continuation, where favor is recalled beside a binding pledge, hearing, and obedience. The repeated favor root and the surrounding response vocabulary create a local contextual resonance without changing the focus's closing statement.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive completed favor as provision that establishes a relationship of response rather than as an isolated concluding benefit.
findings.containment: This is a qualified context delta from 5:7, not a lexical definition of favor or a claim that the purification procedure itself causes the later covenant response.

epistemic.reason: The connection registry marks 5:7 as a medium contextual continuation and the repeated favor/root-response coordinates are exact, but the context projection does not provide an independent target-morphology analysis for the inferred relational effect.

branch_activations.boundary: The contextual resonance does not make the favor word mean covenant, hearing, or obedience.

findings.title: Adalet için dik duruş
findings.claim: The focus's rising into prayer can be overlaid, cautiously, with the later call to stand for justice: an upright ritual posture resonates with remaining straight and measured under hostility.
findings.mechanism: The focus's rising occurrence and the 5:8 standing-for-justice occurrence share the registered qwm branch. Hatred and the paired justice imperatives provide the later pressure-and-calibration frame, while the focus remains the literal prayer posture.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive rising as a local posture of uprightness that opens toward measured conduct rather than merely vertical motion.
findings.containment: This remains exploratory contextual resonance. It does not claim that 5:8 defines purification, that the prayer posture lexically means public justice, or that the context mandates a social interpretation of the rite. The connection carries reciprocal counterevidence and keeps the overlay bounded.

epistemic.reason: The focus and 5:8 occurrences share an exact qwm branch and the context supplies explicit justice language, but the connection is weak and carries reciprocal counterevidence against using the later procedure to explain justice.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Rising into prayer can be perceived as a posture that hints at remaining straight when hostility tests conduct.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay is exploratory and does not claim that the focus's rise lexically entails public justice.

findings.title: Fâtiha'nın yol ve nimet örtüşmesi
findings.claim: The individually listed Fātiḥa words in 1:6 and 1:7 give the focus's intentional substitute, rising posture, and completed favor a way-oriented sequence while leaving the literal purification procedure intact.
findings.mechanism: Three local contacts are retained: deliberate recourse in 5:6 with guidance toward the straight path in 1:6; rising in 5:6 with the straight-path/qwm wording in 1:6; and favor in 5:6 with the path and bestowed-favor wording in 1:7. The overlay uses only these listed word-level contacts, not a whole-surah theme.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the fallback as deliberate orientation, the rising as waykeeping posture, and the completed favor as provision received along a requested path.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory Phase 2 external overlay. It does not equate earth with the straight path, replace the literal prayer, rising, water absence, or earth, identify the favored people, or import the whole of Fātiḥa into 5:6.

epistemic.reason: The cited 1:6 and 1:7 word/root coordinates are exact and individually connected to focus occurrences, but the combined overlay is a writer inference over lean external context rather than a registered channel or direct lexical claim.
